description: This file implements various input device classes and their methods for handling input events such as touch, mouse, keyboard, rotary, and switches within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes functions for sending events, managing touch slots, and handling device disconnections.

classes.name: InputDevice
classes.description: Base class providing the WriteEvents method for input devices.

classes.name: TouchDevice
classes.description: Derived class handling touch input events, multi-touch support, and slot management.

classes.name: MouseDevice
classes.description: Derived class for mouse input, handling move, button, and wheel events.

classes.name: KeyboardDevice
classes.description: Derived class for keyboard input, handling key press and release events.

classes.name: RotaryDevice
classes.description: Derived class for rotary input devices, handling rotation events.

classes.name: SwitchesDevice
classes.description: Derived class for switch input devices, handling switch state events.

methods.name: WriteEvents
methods.description: Sends a buffer of input events through the device connection.

methods.name: SendTouchEvent
methods.description: Sends a single touch event at specified coordinates with touch down/up state.

methods.name: SendMultiTouchEvent
methods.description: Sends multiple touch events for multi-touch support, managing touch slots.

methods.name: HasSlot
methods.description: Checks if a specific slot is currently active for a source and id.

methods.name: GetOrAcquireSlot
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a new slot for a given source and id.

methods.name: ReleaseSlot
methods.description: Releases a specific touch slot associated with a source and id.

methods.name: OnDisconnectedSource
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a source disconnects by releasing associated slots.

methods.name: UseNewSlot
methods.description: Finds and marks a new available slot for touch input.

methods.name: SendMoveEvent
methods.description: Sends a mouse move event with relative x and y movement.

methods.name: SendButtonEvent
methods.description: Sends a mouse button press or release event.

methods.name: SendWheelEvent
methods.description: Sends a mouse wheel scroll event.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Sends a key or switch event depending on device type.
